task: MicroBatcher<T,R>: size-or-time micro-batching of single submits into one bulk call, with injectable Scheduler
reasoning_summary: Items accumulate under a lock; a batch is detached (generation++ and timer cancelled) when full, on timer, flush or close, and the bulk function runs on the worker outside the lock. A generation check makes stale timers harmless even if cancellation races. A tiny Scheduler interface let tests drive time with a manual clock, so only two tests use real threads.
